description.default: T&C Manager reopens, overrides or regrades a graded outcome by setting the final outcome with a mandatory reason (OD-007, AD-031). The initial outcome is preserved so both survive (BR-007). Enforces optimistic concurrency and idempotency, and writes an immutable Audit Event.
